en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an urban square with late‑19th‑century apartment and commercial buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and around a small landscaped area with trees and a kiosk or pavilion. Shop signs in German and Italian line the ground floors. At the top left, the caption reads "GRAZ – Bismarkplatz," indicating the square in the city of Graz.
